milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the jack_o_lantern tower at (~8, 1, ~3) and face toward it, confirming they have visually located the landmark. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the black_stained_glass structure (centered at ~14, 2, ~-2.5) and face toward it. max_distance=10 requires closer proximity since the player needs to eventually enter the structure for the next task. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the glass building.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted wooden_sword ends up in the player's inventory. This is the definitive check for a crafting task — the player must mine oak logs, craft planks, and combine 2 planks + 1 stick on the crafting table to produce the sword. The item is not in the starting inventory so its presence confirms successful crafting.
